findings.claim: README declares Python 3.12 prerequisite while package requires >=3.13,<3.14
findings.impact: Developer installation instructions conflict with enforced package requirement
findings.recommendation: Align documented prerequisite with ratified runtime contract

findings.claim: Ruff target py312 differs from Python package and mypy target 3.13
findings.impact: Inconsistent declared static-analysis target; runtime failure not established
findings.recommendation: Ratify and align the lint target in a future authorized slice

findings.claim: Readiness invokes undefined literal at health.py:91; Pylance reportUndefinedVariable confirms
findings.impact: INFERENCE: caught NameError prevents connectivity check succeeding and leads to degraded readiness despite a healthy database
findings.recommendation: Correct intended SQLAlchemy expression import and verify readiness in an authorized isolated slice

findings.claim: UI upload produces an unpinned DRAFT base but preview selector requires APPROVED plus compatibility ID; no direct named governance web integration found
findings.impact: Fresh upload cannot complete the exposed preview journey without separate governance preparation
findings.recommendation: Reuse governed-base service through explicit authorized scoped compatibility/review workflow; keep upload unapproved

findings.claim: Preview form sends hidden fixed PROD/SITE_A/Overview/LABEL_ONLY values
findings.impact: User cannot select or inspect alternative approved scope/page; route impact still under investigation
findings.recommendation: Derive and show allowed context/page choices from reviewed compatibility and canonical scope

findings.claim: Preview route maps only CTL-002; strict projection blocks any captured confirmed answer with another question code
findings.impact: Conditional source path prevents populated captures with other confirmed questions from reaching preview reservation
findings.recommendation: Use an approved versioned mapping set or explicit reviewed capability projection/exclusion policy; preserve strict blocking of required unsupported facts

findings.claim: ArtifactFinalizationError bypasses _record_finalization_failure after runner committed STORING
findings.impact: Owned validation failures can remain nonterminal until recovery rather than immediately recording sanitized failure
findings.recommendation: Record owned validation failures under phase/version/lease fencing; preserve stale-worker noninterference

findings.claim: SELECT lease/version check followed by ORM finalization may allow an interleaved stale-worker completion
findings.impact: Potential lease replacement overwrite; mapper/SQL/isolation not yet verified
findings.recommendation: Inspect mapper fencing and perform an independently authorized synthetic interleaving before concluding race behavior

findings.claim: Artifact links use individual row presence while inspection_ready only controls explanatory text
findings.impact: Incomplete bundles can show enabled links; metadata-only readiness text overstates receipt verification
findings.recommendation: Separate metadata completeness and verified availability; align controls with server inspection policy

findings.claim: Review service does not revalidate projection bytes/hash or reload source snapshot authority before approval mutation
findings.impact: Selected metadata pins and artifact receipts do not establish full immutable official authority
findings.recommendation: Revalidate canonical projection, source snapshot, semantic identity and policy/bundle association before review; keep activation disabled

findings.claim: ATT Internal Interfaces prose says inbound connectivity while its visual legend includes both IN and OUT
findings.impact: Direction inclusion and color semantics can be implemented inconsistently or omit/include the wrong flows
findings.recommendation: Check the existing approved policy first; if unresolved, obtain an explicit direction/inclusion decision and deterministic N/R mapping while preserving unknown direction

findings.claim: gen_runs.input_id is indexed but has no FK to topo_inputs.id
findings.impact: Orphan governed runs can lose their immutable input authority and become unrenderable/unreviewable
findings.recommendation: Audit/backfill then add a nullable legacy-compatible FK plus governed non-null policy

findings.claim: topo_inputs does not enforce exactly one source authority or mode agreement for snapshot_id/capture_id
findings.impact: Both/neither authority and mode mismatch are structurally possible
findings.recommendation: Add portable conditional authority invariant after existing-data audit; retain service defense in depth

findings.claim: Explicit topology review/reviewer references lack database foreign keys and target-cardinality enforcement
findings.impact: Orphan or contradictory audit references can weaken immutable review lineage
findings.recommendation: Constrain explicit actor/run/base references and valid target combinations with restrictive retention semantics

findings.claim: Snapshot append-only behavior is repository convention; inspected database constraints do not prevent update/delete
findings.impact: Direct session/SQL mutation can alter or remove official authority without an append-only successor
findings.recommendation: Document/enforce database privilege/audit boundary and fail closed on authority tampering; consider portable DB enforcement deliberately

findings.claim: Interface update/retire increment row_version but do not compare an expected version
findings.impact: Concurrent reviewed edits can be lost even though the epoch changes
findings.recommendation: Add expected-version conditional updates and typed conflict handling; advance epoch only on successful CAS

findings.claim: Resource/link head current_revision_id columns have no FK or same-owner constraint
findings.impact: Orphan/cross-owner current revision pointers are structurally possible and can block capture
findings.recommendation: Add portable head-to-owned-revision integrity after data audit while preserving atomic bootstrap/CAS

findings.claim: reparent_resource creates a revision with new parent but common head CAS does not update head parent_id
findings.impact: A successful reparent leaves head/current revision inconsistent and governed capture rejects the resource
findings.recommendation: Atomically update effective parent/state with current revision pointer in the same CAS

findings.claim: Typed resource-link models/readers exist but no production writer/command was located under src/migration_intake
findings.impact: Reviewed explicit resource relationships cannot be established through the located application boundary
findings.recommendation: Implement scoped CAS/review link commands or explicitly defer/remove this authority path; never infer canonical links from diagram geometry

findings.claim: Alembic implicitly loads Path.cwd()/.env when no explicit migration URL is present
findings.impact: A migration command can target an unintended existing database configured by working-directory dotenv
findings.recommendation: Require explicit online migration target/acknowledgement or explicit dotenv opt-in with redacted target checks

findings.claim: Alembic SQLite online engine omits the application's foreign-key connection pragmas and post-upgrade integrity check
findings.impact: Migration/data-fix operations may run without SQLite FK enforcement
findings.recommendation: Configure migration integrity pragmas and controlled post-upgrade foreign-key validation

findings.claim: Docker Compose health uses /health/live and therefore does not certify DB/schema/storage/catalog readiness
findings.impact: Orchestration can mark a dependency-unready application healthy
findings.recommendation: Repair/validate readiness, then separate readiness from liveness in deployment probes

findings.claim: Interface projection substitutes selected single context for absent row scope and marks it EXPLICIT
findings.impact: Current preview invents PROD/SITE_A certainty and cannot safely partition the two-page target
findings.recommendation: Persist reviewed interface scope; selection filters facts but never supplies missing evidence

findings.claim: Interface endpoint nodes are keyed only by counterpart ID while flows carry scope
findings.impact: Same counterpart across contexts can collapse to one node with mismatched scoped flows
findings.recommendation: Use canonical scoped endpoint identity/namespace and retain display identity separately

findings.claim: Guide region/category is computed then omitted from projected flow and dedup identity; several approved internal labels lack aliases
findings.impact: Renderer cannot deterministically place ATT/AWS/Azure flows and cross-region flows can collapse
findings.recommendation: Persist typed approved category in flow identity and block unknown mandatory categories

findings.claim: Resource capture stores top-level provenance_references but projector reads revision.provenance_references
findings.impact: Projected resource node provenance is silently empty
findings.recommendation: Use one strict typed resource shape and preserve revision provenance through projection/render/review

findings.claim: Semantic projector adds every captured resource node independently of selected partitions/lifecycle/scope
findings.impact: Off-context/source/unknown resources can appear in persisted semantic nodes; renderer impact pending
findings.recommendation: Build semantic nodes from explicit selected/shared sets and validate every flow endpoint

findings.claim: Only synthetic packaged profiles exist; no reviewed profile for the supplied Outposts base and application-specific two-page target is present
findings.impact: Governed compatibility/rendering cannot truthfully claim reproduction of the actual target
findings.recommendation: Create and approve a hash-pinned application/template structural profile from supplied evidence; do not promote synthetic fixtures

findings.claim: Synthetic label-only profile binds only APPLICATION_NAME on Overview and cannot express target topology semantics
findings.impact: Successful label fill is not proof of two-page structural topology generation
findings.recommendation: Keep LABEL_ONLY claims bounded and implement a separate reviewed STRUCTURAL target profile

findings.claim: Active base compatibility/rendering does not enforce manifest projection-version range or required resource kinds
findings.impact: A profile can be used outside its declared projection contract while compatibility reports success
findings.recommendation: Use one persisted typed projection compatibility gate and revalidate it in rendering

findings.claim: Structural compatibility requires prototypes but renderer ignores them and creates unstyled cells
findings.impact: Generated output cannot preserve target icons/styles/arrows/metadata despite passing prototype checks
findings.recommendation: Clone exact page-scoped approved prototypes and audit only governed mutations

findings.claim: Generated node/edge identity and endpoint lookup omit scope/category; edge identity also omits relationship type
findings.impact: Scoped/category variants can collapse, collide or connect to the wrong generated node
findings.recommendation: Hash one canonical scoped typed semantic identity and separate display labels

findings.claim: Renderer always blocks capacity overflow even when profile declares CONTINUATION_PAGE
findings.impact: Declared multi-page overflow capability does not exist
findings.recommendation: Implement governed continuation cloning or explicitly govern BLOCK behavior; do not certify continuation prematurely

findings.claim: Compatibility/renderer use document-global cell IDs, while the actual two-page target reuses 104 effective IDs across pages
findings.impact: The active lookup can overwrite valid page-local cells and validate/mutate the wrong target page
findings.recommendation: Key every region/prototype/cell by page identity plus cell ID and enforce page hierarchy ownership

findings.claim: Recovery attempt cap checks reservation attempt_number, but expired-lease claims never increment a recovery counter
findings.impact: Initial runs can recover indefinitely while later rerun numbers can be denied first recovery
findings.recommendation: Add dedicated atomically incremented recovery_attempt_count and enforce the cap in the claim UPDATE

findings.claim: Recovery inventory/reconciliation query only lease-bearing runs and scan only the oldest first 100
findings.impact: Terminal/lease-free/newer runs can be reported absent and their artifacts cannot be diagnosed through this service
findings.recommendation: Use exact scoped run lookup for reconciliation and SQL-bounded inventory separately

findings.claim: HTTP approval route calls legacy unfenced approval instead of TopologyReviewService
findings.impact: Feature-flag activation bypasses authority/bundle/readiness checks, CAS and append review audit
findings.recommendation: Wire only the repaired governed review service and keep official activation disabled until certified

findings.claim: Artifact routes inconsistently verify preview versus official bytes; official manifest uses preview-only verifier and typed review errors are unhandled
findings.impact: Official bytes can bypass receipts, visible links can fail as generic server errors, and official manifest delivery is broken
findings.recommendation: Create one mode-aware scoped verified delivery boundary with explicit HTTP error mapping and inspection policy

findings.claim: Assessment section 7 no longer represents current checkout status; several blanket gaps are remediated while newer critical defects are absent
findings.impact: Using the dated matrix for release decisions can overstate old gaps and miss current activation blockers
findings.recommendation: Retain it as a dated baseline and link the final current-worktree evidence matrix

findings.claim: Active plan marks TP07-TP14 complete despite current source contradictions; HTML TP13-TP15 statuses are stale
findings.impact: Agents/release reviewers can treat broken invariants as certified and choose the wrong next work
findings.recommendation: Preserve history but publish dated REOPEN_REQUIRED corrective overlay and synchronize HTML after approval

historical_leads.scope: Orientation document inspected; no test counts or suite-derived claims are admissible under the updated exclusion; source-based concerns require independent revalidation
historical_leads.next: Revalidate in bounded production-source or separately authorized standalone probe chunks after baseline permission is resolved

note: Initialization establishes repository/reference metadata only. No new architecture findings or test results are claimed.
